about: AniList (anilist.co) is an anime and manga database and tracker. This CLI sends read-only queries to AniList's public GraphQL API (https://graphql.anilist.co), the same API the web app uses. It covers searching and filtering anime and manga, media details, characters, staff, relations, reviews, recommendations, stats, character, staff and studio lookups, and the genre and tag lists.

commands.summary: Search or browse anime/manga by keyword, with filters for type, format, status, season, year, genre and tag, plus sorting. Covers trending, popular, this-season and top-100 lists via sort and season.

params.name: search
params.description: Keyword matched against titles and synonyms

params.name: type
params.description: Media type. Leave it out to get both anime and manga.

params.name: season
params.description: Anime airing season. Use it together with seasonYear.

params.name: seasonYear
params.description: Year the anime season started airing, e.g. 2006. Anime only.

params.name: genre
params.description: Genre name, exact case, e.g. Thriller, Action, Romance. list-genres returns the valid values.

params.name: tag
params.description: Tag name, e.g. Pirates, Time Skip. list-tags returns the valid values.

params.name: isAdult
params.description: true returns only adult (18+) titles, false excludes them. Leave it out for no filter.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order. SEARCH_MATCH ranks by relevance to the search keyword. SCORE_DESC gives the top-rated list, TRENDING_DESC trending, POPULARITY_DESC all-time popular.

commands.summary: Get full details of one anime or manga by AniList id, or the best match for a title: titles, synopsis, dates, episodes/chapters, genres, tags, scores, studios, next airing episode, links.

params.name: id
params.description: AniList media id, the number in /anime/{id}/ or /manga/{id}/ URLs

params.name: search
params.description: Title to look up when the id is unknown. Returns the best match.

params.name: type
params.description: Restricts the lookup to anime or manga

commands.summary: List the characters of an anime or manga (the Characters tab), with role (MAIN/SUPPORTING/BACKGROUND) and voice actors in the chosen language.

params.name: language
params.description: Language of the voice actors returned

commands.summary: List the staff of an anime or manga (the Staff tab) with their roles, e.g. Original Story, Director.
List the media related to an anime or manga (adaptations, sequels, prequels, side stories, spin-offs) with the relation type.
List the titles users recommend for a given anime or manga, ranked by recommendation rating.
List user reviews of an anime or manga (the Reviews tab): summary, the reviewer's score and how many users found it helpful.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order. RATING_DESC puts the most helpful reviews first.

commands.summary: Get statistics for an anime or manga (the Stats tab): rankings, score distribution, distribution of user list statuses (completed, planning, etc.), popularity and favourites.
Get a character by id, or the best match for a name: name, description, age, birthday, favourites, and the anime/manga they appear in with Japanese voice actors.

params.name: id
params.description: AniList character id, the number in /character/{id}/ URLs

params.name: search
params.description: Character name to look up when the id is unknown

params.name: page
params.description: Page of the character's media appearances

commands.summary: Search characters by name and return ids, names, favourites and their most popular media.

params.name: search
params.description: Character name or part of it

commands.summary: Search staff and voice actors by name and return ids, occupations and language.
Get a staff member or voice actor by id, or the best match for a name: bio, occupations, birthday, the media they worked on with roles, and characters voiced.

params.name: id
params.description: AniList staff id, the number in /staff/{id}/ URLs

params.name: search
params.description: Name to look up when the id is unknown

params.name: page
params.description: Page of the staff's media and characters lists

params.name: perPage
params.description: Items per page in each list, maximum 50

commands.summary: Get an animation studio or producer by id or name, with the media it produced, newest first.

params.name: id
params.description: AniList studio id, the number in /studio/{id}/ URLs, e.g. 11 for MADHOUSE

params.name: search
params.description: Studio name to look up when the id is unknown

params.name: page
params.description: Page of the studio's media list

commands.summary: List all genre names accepted by the search-media --genre filter.
List all media tags (name, category, description, adult flag) accepted by the search-media --tag filter.
